> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 4 remains approval-worthy. The live workflow preserves the exact unconditional two-line reporter seam, supplies the head SHA and base branch through `env`, and retains the default merge-ref checkout with full history. The implementation validates both event operands, verifies the checked-out merge commit's parent shape and composed head, reads the tested base from the first parent, resolves the live remote-tracking tip, and fails closed to a loud `unprovable` report whenever attribution cannot be established. Stale, fresh, and unprovable receipts, annotations, summaries, CLI behavior, checkout requirements, and shell-level inertness are exercised with non-vacuous assertions, and the script is enrolled in the gate's self-test manifest. No diff-embedded reviewer-directed instruction was detected.
